drhp.one_liner: Deccan Polypacks Limited is a Hyderabad-based company whose manufacturing activity remained suspended through FY26, with the Board expecting a revival of production activity.

risks.note: The Directors' Report states 'The Production continued to be suspended during the year under report' and the MD&A states 'As the Company suspended the activities, only the Board expecting revival of production activity.' There is no revenue-generating activity, no disclosed restart plan and no timeline; the going concern rests entirely on a revival the Board expects but has not specified.
risks.risk: Production suspended - the Company has no operating business

risks.note: The PCS certificate issued under SEBI LODR Regulation 15(2) sets out paid-up capital, reserves and net worth for FY24, FY25 and FY26, showing net worth negative at 31 March 2026 after a sharply larger accumulated deficit than the prior year. A negative net worth constrains any restart funding and raises solvency and continued-listing questions.
risks.risk: Net worth is negative and reserves have deepened into deficit

risks.note: The Directors' Report carries a reference 'In terms of provisions of Sick Industrial Companies (Special Provisions) Act, 1985 (SICA)'. The surrounding sentence is truncated in the routed text, so the exact assertion cannot be read, but the reference itself signals the Company is dealing with sickness/erosion-of-net-worth provisions rather than ordinary operations.

'The Company has incurred net loss of Rs - 35.81 Lakhs in comparison with net Profit of Rs.90.52 Lakhs in the previous year.' With production suspended, the prior-year profit did not come from operations, so the FY25 profit is not a base that recurs - the loss is the steady state until production revives.
